Proposition
[The Recursion Produces an Orthonormal Tuple]

↗ def:gram-schmidt-bilin-normed ↗ lem:gram-schmidt-bilin-nonvanishing ↗ lem:gram-schmidt-bilin-orthogonal

For symmetric $B$ and a nondegenerate tuple $v$, the tuple $b=\widehat{\mathrm{GS}}_B(v)$ satisfies \[ B(b_i,b_j)=0\quad (i\ne j), \qquad B(b_j,b_j)=\pm 1. \]

Proof

↗ def:gram-schmidt-bilin-normed ↗ lem:gram-schmidt-bilin-nonvanishing ↗ lem:gram-schmidt-bilin-orthogonal \sketch Writing $b_j=\lambda _ju_j$ with $\lambda _j=|B(u_j,u_j)|^{-1/2}$, orthogonality of the $u_j$ gives the off-diagonal equalities, while

\[ B(b_j,b_j)=\frac{B(u_j,u_j)}{|B(u_j,u_j)|}\in \{ 1,-1\} . \]

□
